question: Which state secured over all third position in the medals tally at the 36th National Games (2022) of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Haryana secured the overall third position** in the medals tally at the 36th National Games (2022) of India. 
 
• They** won** 34 gold, 33 silver, and 39 bronze medals, totaling 106 medals
 
• ** Maharashtra came in second**, with 38 gold medals and a total of 138 medals 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• National Games of India

 
 
• The National Games of India comprises various disciplines in which sportsmen from the different states of India participate against each other.
 
• The first such event was held in Lahore in the year 1924.
 
• The country's first few Olympic Games, now renamed as National Games, were held in North India (Delhi, Lahore, Allahabad, Patiala), Chennai, Calcutta, and Mumbai.
 
• For several years in the mid-twentieth century, the national games were conducted on a low-key note.
 
• However, the first Modern National Games on the lines of the Olympics were held in 1985 in New Delhi.
